title: Hangboard Protocol Load Baseline Drift Alert
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hangboard:protocol
| timechart span=1d avg(load_kg) as metric
| eventstats avg(metric) as base, stdev(metric) as sd
| eval delta=round(metric-base,2), drift=if(abs(delta)>2*sd,1,0)
| where drift=1
description: Flags days where hangboard protocol load moved far away from your recent baseline instead of staying within normal variation.
value: Large baseline drift is a quick way to surface bad days, breakout days, or sensor issues without waiting for a coach's manual review.
implementation: Schedule this daily after ingesting hangboard protocol load events and investigate any drift days alongside notes about fatigue, travel, or conditions.
visualization: Timechart of daily added load in kilograms with baseline and drift markers.
grandmaExplanation: It blends when hangboard protocol load suddenly looks very different from your normal pattern.
